d: Snoonu is seeking a highly driven and analytical Category Manager to lead our Home and Pet products. This role is critical in shaping our assortment, improving profitability, and enhancing the customer experience across our dark store network. As a Category Manager, you will take full ownership of the performance, availability, and commercial success of your category, working closely with cross-functional teams including Supply Chain, Operations, and Marketing to ensure the right products are available at the right time and price

Analytical and detail-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Proactive, adaptable, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

d: Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
q: Minimum 15 years of experience in Brownfield Oil & Gas Piping Design and Engineering.
Experience performing as a professional Piping Engineer for projects and plant modifications from Front-End Engineering Design (FEED) through execution, commissioning, and start-up.
Demonstrated experience in piping design, material selection, pipe routing, stress analysis, and engineering support for oil and gas facilities.
Minimum 5-10 years of experience leading piping engineering activities within multidisciplinary project delivery teams.
Experience in the Middle East is an advantage.
Experience in front-end engineering, project execution, commissioning, and start-up activities.
Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.
Professional Engineering status or equivalent professional registration.
Proven leadership skills and a strong personal drive to meet deadlines and targets.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
Ability to work and manage in a multicultural environment.
Strong commitment to HSSE leadership and experience managing HSSE throughout all project phases.
Experience in the design, selection, specification, and implementation of piping systems.

r: Ensure company and statutory requirements, along with applicable engineering standards, are identified and addressed in piping design across all Purchase Orders and Programmes.
Maintain up-to-date knowledge of relevant industry standards and ensure project designs comply with current requirements.
Ensure the technical integrity of piping deliverables through checking, verification, and design review activities.
Proactively understand the safety hazards and risks associated with the asset lifecycle of the designed product, plant, or system.
Ensure actions arising from Project Reviews and Value Improvement Practices (VIPs) are addressed in a timely manner.
Design and develop innovative technical approaches to piping engineering challenges and contribute to continuous business improvement initiatives.
Communicate key design decisions with potential safety impacts to project teams and ensure they are appropriately documented.

Drive continuous improvement in the effectiveness and efficiency of project delivery through elimination, simplification, standardization, and automation while maintaining high-quality engineering outcomes.
Plan the execution of piping discipline activities to maintain project schedules.
Manage quality and consistency within the discipline.
Provide technical direction, control, and supervision for engineering and design activities.
Prepare discipline man-hour estimates for proposals and develop deliverables lists.
Deliver discipline design deliverables within approved man-hour budgets.
Manage discipline resources in collaboration with the Project Engineering Manager.
Identify software requirements and select appropriate design tools.
Identify training and development needs of discipline personnel.
Perform or delegate checking of deliverables.
Report progress on deliverables and tasks and provide updates for project reporting.
Identify and report potential project variances.
Maintain and update lessons learned registers.
Undertake or delegate site visits as required.
Manage interfaces within the discipline, across other disciplines, and with third-party contractors.
Interface with procurement and construction teams.
Coordinate change control and technical query processes within the discipline.
